name: 🏺 Bottle of Boundless Coffee
notes: This container has an endless supply of coffee.

name: 🔧 Manifold Tool
notes: A multi-tool that can be transformed into various implements.

name: 📿 Bead of Nourishment
notes: This flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves on your tongue and provides enough nourishment to sustain you for a day.

name: 🧪 Potion of Climbing
notes: When you drink this potion, you gain a Climb Speed equal to your walking speed.

name: 🎒 Bag of Holding
notes: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its exterior size, capable of holding up to 500 pounds.

name: 🐍 Bag of Tricks
notes: This ordinary bag appears empty, but reaching inside reveals a pair of wooden stakes, a length of cord, and a rubber chicken.

name: 🥾 Boots of Elvenkind
notes: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the ground or surface you are walking on.

name: 🌿 Cloak of Elvenkind
notes: While you wear this cloak with its hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have disadvantage.

name: 🧥 Cloak of Protection
notes: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak of fine-spun material.

name: 📿 Headband of Intellect
notes: Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on a creature that already has a score of 19 or higher.

name: 💠 Pearl of Power
notes: While this pearl is on your person, you can take a Magic Action to touch it and store a spell in it.

name: 📿 Amulet of Health
notes: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on a creature that already has a score of 19 or higher.

name: 🫘 Bag of Beans
notes: Inside this heavy cloth bag are 3d4 dry beans. The bag weighs 3 pounds and is unremarkable in appearance.

name: 🧪 Elixir of Health
notes: When you drink this potion, you are cured of all diseases and poison, and you regain hit points.

name: 🧤 Gloves of Thievery
notes: These gloves are imperceptible while worn. While wearing them, you have advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks.

name: 💍 Ring of Protection
notes: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this ring.

name: 🪄 Wand of Wonder
notes: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic Action to expend 1 charge to produce one of six effects.

name: 🔮 Crystal Ball
notes: The typical crystal ball is about the size of a large glass marble and worth 1,000 gp. Using it requires attunement.

name: ❄️ Frost Brand
notes: When you hit with an attack using this magic sword, the target takes an extra 1d6 cold damage.

name: 🌬️ Horseshoes of a Zephyr
notes: These iron horseshoes come in a set of four. While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse, they grant it a fly speed of 30 feet.

name: 🦯 Staff of Fire
notes: You have Resistance to Fire Damage while you hold this staff. It can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: ⚔️ Sword of Sharpness
notes: When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize the damage dealt to that target.

name: 🃏 Deck of Many Things
notes: Usually found in a box or pouch, this deck contains 37 cards of oiled, vegetable parchment. Each card is worth 100 gp.

name: 🔨 Hammer of Thunderbolts
notes: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, usable only against undead.

name: 💍 Ring of Three Wishes
notes: While wearing this ring, you can expend 1 of its 3 charges to use your action to cast the wish spell without needing any of the normal spell's components.

name: ☀️ Sunsword
notes: A +3 longsword of solid sunlight with a platinum hilt and crystal blade; it deals extra radiant damage and can blind enemies on a critical hit.
